originStory.title: Built By a Prolific Creator, For Creators

originStory.story: Look at what these systems have produced: 3 published books. Hundreds of articles and newsletters. 20+ digital products including courses, workshops, templates, and tools. 2,000+ sales. The Knowii Community with 400+ members. A voice AI app. Obsidian plugins. A knowledge base of 3,800+ concepts. Nearly 10,000 personal notes. All of this while working half-time at a major financial organization and raising 3 kids. I'm not sharing theory about how to create; I'm sharing the exact systems that produced this output. The systems that took me from scattered ideas and burnout cycles to consistent, sustainable creation that actually generates revenue. If you want to create prolifically without burning out, you need systems that actually work. These are the systems.
originStory.inspirationPoint: The moment I realized I could share not just what I created, but HOW I created it, the systems that made prolific output possible without sacrificing everything else.

creatorJourney.title: From Scattered Ideas to 20+ Products
creatorJourney.subtitle: The systems behind prolific creation
creatorJourney.story: I've been coding since age 8 and writing almost as long. But for years, I struggled with the same problems every creator faces: scattered ideas, inconsistent output, burnout cycles. The turning point came when I stopped trying to create through willpower and started building systems. Today, those systems have produced: 3 books (Learn TypeScript, Dev Concepts series). Hundreds of articles and newsletters across 200+ editions. 20+ digital products including the Obsidian Starter Kit, Knowledge Worker Kit, courses, workshops, masterclasses. The Knowii Community itself. A voice AI app (Knowii Voice). Open-source Obsidian plugins. A PKM Library with 290+ tools and 2,000+ influencers catalogued. Nearly 10,000 notes in my personal vault. All while working half-time as an IT Solution Architect and being a father of 3. The systems work. Now I want to help you build yours.
